modal.title: Plugins would be switched off
modal.text:
Apply would move or switch off 2 plugin(s) or mod(s), so the game would not load them. 1 of them only because a master of theirs is switched off too (a chain).

Nothing has been written yet. Check the list (Show Details) before you choose.
modal.informative:
Either way, Apply adds 9 separator(s), retires 0 and re-sorts the left pane (8 mod(s) move). "Apply, leave plugins as they are" leaves plugins.txt and loadorder.txt exactly as they are: no plugin is moved, ticked, unticked or reordered.

Cascade Needs A Missing Mod.esp  (Cascade - Needs A Missing Mod): needs Not Installed Anywhere.esm - not in any enabled mod, the game's Data folder or Overwrite
Cascade Chain From The Missing One.esp  (Cascade - Chain From The Missing One): needs Cascade Needs A Missing Mod.esp, which cannot load either (a chain from Cascade Needs A Missing Mod.esp)
